render_free_512mb_safety_analysis.assessment: DistilGPT-2 (FP32) + BiLSTM combined consumes ~390-410 MB peak RSS. On Render Free (512 MB cap), this operates close to the 512 MB boundary (~100 MB headroom). Lazy loading of DistilGPT-2 and running garbage collection ensures the service starts safely at ~170 MB (BiLSTM only) and only loads DistilGPT-2 on demand.
